en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a person seated alone on an old single‑chair ski lift, suspended high above a valley. Below lies a small alpine village with scattered houses and meadows, surrounded by dense forest. In the background, dramatic jagged mountains with patches of snow dominate the skyline under a partly cloudy sky. The image has a white border and looks like a vintage tourist postcard.
